source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 762 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 762 was established by Ordinance No. 27277, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 13, 2008. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 762 is established on property located north of Mountain Creek Parkway and east of Mountain Creek Lake. The size of PD 762 is approximately 128.071 acres. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this district:

(1) PRIVATE ELECTRICAL GENERATING PLANT means a privately-owned facility that generates electricity from mechanical power produced by natural gas, solar radiation, water, wind, geothermal energy, or biomass.

(2) STREET YARD means that portion of a lot between a building facade facing a street and the property line.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 762A: conceptual plan.

(2) Exhibit 762B: development plan (Phase I).

(3) Exhibit 762C: development plan (Phase II). (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.105. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 762A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Development of the Property is in two phases as shown on the conceptual plan and the development plans. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Development Plans
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.106. DEVELOPMENT PLANS.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plans (Exhibits 762B and 762C). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plans, the text of this article controls. If there is a conflict between the conceptual plan and the development plans, the development plans control. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.107. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the LI Light Industrial District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the LI Light Industrial District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the LI Light Industrial District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the LI Light Industrial District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional use is permitted by right:

-- Private electrical generating plant. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.108. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.109. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51 A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot and space regulations for the LI Light Industrial District apply.

(b) Height for a private electrical generating plant.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 120 feet.

(2) Except for vent stacks, smokestacks, or other ventilating structures, any portion of a structure over 36 feet in height may not be located above the residential proximity slope. See Section 51A-4.412 for the site of origination.

(3) For vent stacks, smokestacks, or other ventilation structures, maximum structure height is 200 feet. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a private electrical generating plant, a minimum of 18 off-street parking spaces are required. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Landscaping for a private electrical generating plant. The following requirements apply in lieu of the mandatory landscaping and design standards requirements in Division 51A-10.120:

(1) A minimum of 20 percent of the street yard must be landscaped, and may include ground cover, shrubs, trees, or seasonal plantings.

(2) One tree must be provided within the street yard for every 50 feet of street frontage. Existing trees in the street yard shown on a tree survey may count towards this requirement.

(c) Maintenance. Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy growing condition. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27277)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-762.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 762 is located on Zoning Map Nos. L-3, L-4, M-3, and M-4. (Ord. 27277)
